brazil_sources.title: PCDT Estratégias para Atenuar a Progressão da Doença Renal Crônica
key_findings: The Portaria explicitly states that the PCDT is national and must be used by state, DF and municipal SUS managers.
The PCDT recommends CKD-EPI and its displayed equation is adapted from Levey et al. 2009.
The PCDT CKD staging and urinary ACR categories are adapted from KDIGO 2012.

Never infer race or ancestry.
Recheck PCDT, SBN/SBPC-ML and Ministry AKI sources during final v2.0 qualification.

items.international_reference: General acid-base, anion-gap, osmolality and hyperglycaemia references

brazil_sources.title: Fluxograma: Manejo da intoxicação por metanol pelo consumo de bebidas alcoólicas adulteradas
key_findings: The Ministry methanol pathway uses a toxicology-specific anion-gap formula including potassium.
It specifies a protocol-specific calculated osmolality and osmolar gap.
It uses methanol-specific acid-base thresholds and warns that normal early gaps do not exclude poisoning.

required_actions: Do not alter the existing general anion-gap, osmolality, albumin-correction, corrected-sodium, Winter or delta-ratio formulas.
Add a clearly separated Ministry methanol/toxicology context rather than modifying the general calculator.
Never select or apply methanol/toxicology context automatically from chemistry values.
Require explicit potassium for the Ministry potassium-inclusive anion gap.
Require measured osmolality for osmolar-gap calculation.
Keep urea and BUN semantically distinct and enforce explicit units/conversions.
Do not infer methanol poisoning from gap values alone.
Keep Ministry diagnostic/prognostic thresholds context-specific rather than universal.
Preserve exact federal source/version provenance.
Repeat Ministry/SAES/ANVISA/CIATox source freshness review during final v2.0 qualification.
items.scope_pt: O fluxo federal para intoxicação por metanol possui fórmulas e limiares toxicológicos próprios. Eles devem ser implementados somente em contexto explicitamente selecionado e não substituem o painel metabólico geral.
items.scope_en: The federal methanol-poisoning workflow contains its own toxicology formulae and thresholds. They must be exposed only in an explicitly selected context and do not replace the general metabolic toolkit.

8.primary_source: Instrução Normativa do Calendário Nacional de Vacinação 2026
implementation_rules: Apply later 2026 DPNI technical notes and rectifications when they explicitly update a vaccine-specific baseline rule.
Require vaccination history whenever the official recommendation depends on previous doses.
Preserve unknown vaccination history as distinct from documented zero-dose history.
Keep routine, seasonal/campaign, rescue, outbreak and special-condition pathways separate.
Keep recommended intervals distinct from exceptional minimum intervals.
Use effective-date-aware rules for midyear changes such as the 2026 VPC20 transition.
Do not generalize geographically restricted or outbreak-specific vaccination rules nationwide.
Never create a synthetic vaccination score.
